build_keypoint_sampler: build a KeypointSamplerV1 instance from a DictConfig with prompt keypoints and keybody index lists
sample_keypoints_v1: sample prompt keypoints from ground truth and predicted 2D keypoints using KeypointSamplerV1
get_worst_keypoint: get the worst keypoint index from a distance tensor filtered by a keypoint list
get_random_keypoint: get a random valid keypoint index from candidates with positive distances in a keypoint list
compute_masked_distance: compute pairwise squared distances between two tensors with optional masking for ignored elements
